description: This file defines the CloudWatchLogsClient class which extends AwsClient to interact with the Amazon CloudWatch Logs service. It includes methods for various CloudWatch Logs operations, middleware configuration for streaming commands, and a helper generator method for streaming live tail results.

classes.name: CloudWatchLogsClient
classes.description: Extends AwsClient for communicating with Amazon CloudWatch Logs API, managing streaming commands, and providing a helper for live tail stream processing.

methods.name: addStreamingFlagMiddleware
methods.description: Adds middleware to handle streaming flag for designated commands.

methods.name: getStreamingFlagMiddleware
methods.description: Creates middleware that sets a 'stream' flag in the HTTP request for specific commands.

methods.name: startLiveTailCheckingForResults
methods.description: Initiates 'startLiveTail' operation and yields log stream chunks, filtering for session updates and results.
